evidence.trustReason: Re-verification after fix a68c608a3a. Ran delegate.test.ts: 5 pass, 0 fail, 11 expect, exit 0; RM26 TUI test: 1 pass, exit 0; full task-ui file 29 pass. Happy Path: delegate(packages/tui, task-ui.test.tsx, RM26) must return exactly the RM26 title, read from the nested run's JUnit report. Error Propagation: no-match pattern gives 'no test matched'; failing test gives its title and expect(received).toBe(expected). Boundary: a skipped-only match gives 'no test matched'; the report is read with Junit from src/task/proof/junit.ts. Resource Limits (earlier gap closed): the hanging sample test writes the nested bun pid; after a 5 s timeout the test asserts 'timed out' in under 40 s AND that the pid is gone within 10 s; a new test forks the delegate, asserts the pid alive, interrupts the fiber, and asserts the pid gone within 10 s. Without the group kill the process lives up to 60 s, so both checks fail. Backwards Compatibility RM26: unchanged task-ui (no packages/tui/src diff from dev) renders fixture-phase1.json on the Board: STOPPED 3, WAITING 0, T1.5 and T1 cards, two 'blocked' labels and 'blocked by T1.4: budget exhausted' twice; delegate.test.ts runs it through the helper.
